instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Wealth management advisory serving 400+ high-net-worth families with holistic financial planning, tax optimization, and estate structuring. Blending in-person advisory with a client portal for portfolio tracking. Seeking to enhance client reporting with interactive scenario modeling tools. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: Innovation is embedded in our operating rhythm. We run quarterly hackathons, maintain a formal patent portfolio, and have a rotating 'innovation fellow' program where high-potential employees spend 6 months dedicated to exploratory projects. Our last hackathon produced a prototype for automated quality inspection using computer vision that is now in production, reducing defect escape rate by 35%.
answers.strategicGoals: We are the incumbent market leader but face increasing pressure from 2 well-funded new entrants who are undercutting our pricing and offering a more modern customer experience. Our priority is defending our installed base — reducing churn, strengthening switching costs, and matching the digital experience our competitors offer without triggering a destructive price war.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-15 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 5 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.
answers.additionalContext: We are 3 months into fundraising conversations with growth equity investors who are conducting deep due diligence on our technology and operations. Their feedback indicates concern about our digital maturity relative to peers. We need to quickly identify and launch 2-3 innovation initiatives that will address these concerns and strengthen our fundraising narrative.

input.changes_since_last: Completed 2 strategic partnerships. Revenue growth 20% YoY. Exploring AI/ML capabilities.

opportunities.title: Digital Client Experience & Switching Costs Enhancement (Portfolio View)
opportunities.rationale: The market defense strategy requires matching competitor UX while strengthening client lock-in. Enhancing the existing portal with interactive scenario modeling directly addresses client pain points and provides a crucial differentiator beyond just pricing.

first_actions: Conduct competitive teardowns of top 3 rival digital portals to map feature parity gaps.
Pilot high-fidelity wireframes for advanced, interactive scenario modeling (e.g., tax impact/withdrawal rate changes).
Establish a dedicated cross-functional task force involving Tech, Advisory, and Sales leads.
resources_needed: Advanced Data Engineering support for simulation back-end
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase in average weekly logins to the client portal by 15% within 6 months.
milestones: Completion of core simulation logic integration (Month 4)
Pilot launch with 20 high-value clients for feedback (Month 6)

opportunities.title: AI-Powered Predictive Wealth Management Insights Platform
opportunities.rationale: To satisfy growth equity due diligence and leapfrog current competitors, Forge must transition from reactive reporting to proactive prediction. Leveraging AI/ML on holistic client data (beyond standard portfolio metrics) creates a unique, defensible value proposition.

first_actions: Map all internal datasets required for predictive modeling (tax law changes, economic indicators, behavioral science inputs).
Develop Minimum Viable Product (MVP) model focused on predicting client churn risk rather than just portfolio performance.
Identify a small sandbox environment to test models without impacting core production systems.
resources_needed: Compliance and Legal review of data usage protocols
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful deployment and validation of the churn prediction model with >80% sensitivity in a pilot group.
milestones: Initial predictive dashboard deployed to R&D team (Month 5)
Integration into client-facing advisory workflow concepts (Month 7)

next_steps.action: Formalize the strategic narrative for investors by quantifying the value and timeline of opp_3 (AI Platform).
Overhaul the internal business case approval process for mid-cycle innovation projects to reduce stakeholder friction and time-to-market.
Allocate a dedicated, small 'Fast Track' budget pool for highly vetted, low-overhead market defense experiments.

key_weaknesses: Process Rigidity: The established but rigid internal governance structure (formal business case chain) acts as a critical bottleneck for rapid innovation.
Market Vulnerability: Despite market leadership, reliance on traditional advisory services leaves the firm vulnerable to modern digital experiences and direct pricing attacks from new entrants.
Digital Confidence Gap: Investor due diligence highlights an ongoing concern regarding the maturity of technology infrastructure relative to rapidly evolving competitors.

improvements: Strong market defense focus: The shift in priority is clearly defined by competitive pressure and fundraising needs.
Proven execution capability: Successful deployment of solutions derived from hackathons demonstrates operational agility at the team level (e.g., 35% defect reduction).
Strategic partnerships completed, fueling revenue growth.
persistent_gaps: Internal Governance: The process bottlenecks identified in the prior assessment remain structural hurdles.
Cross-functional Alignment: Coordinating efforts between R&D, Advisory, and Technology remains complex, slowing initiative deployment.
Formalizing AI Roadmap: Moving from 'exploring' AI/ML to a concrete, governed product line needs significant resource commitment.
achieved_milestones: The completion of the automated quality inspection prototype (35% reduction).
Establishing clear go/no-go criteria using lean startup methodology for new projects.
Completion of strategic partnerships supporting YoY revenue growth.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Shift from a general focus on optimization to aggressive market defense and fundraising readiness. The company has moved past merely establishing internal processes and is now actively planning radical, high-impact initiatives (AI/ML) necessary to stabilize the investment narrative.
